name: scribble-circle
title: Scribble Circle
description: A hand-drawn marker circle scribbles itself around a target in stop-motion poses.
useWhen: A price, number or option should be circled by hand to direct attention to it.
A paper, scrapbook or stop-motion look is wanted.
avoidWhen: You need a precise, geometric highlight ring.
The target moves: the circle is placed on a fixed spot.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Rows
variables.description: JSON array of {name, price} rows shown on the card.

variables.label: Circled row
variables.description: Index of the row whose price gets circled (0 is the first).

variables.label: Laps
variables.description: How many times the pen goes around.

variables.label: Opening pressure
variables.description: Stroke width at the start, as a fraction of the stroke width.

variables.label: Grain
variables.description: How rough the ink edge is.

variables.label: Drawing poses
variables.description: Number of poses the scribble takes.

variables.label: Frames per pose
variables.description: How many frames each drawing pose is held.
